claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.useContextFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The advantage on Arcana checks is restricted to checks made specifically to control a Sphere of Annihilation, not all Arcana checks. The surface has skillFilter but no context-of-use predicate. Encoding without it overstates the grant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on any Intelligence (Arcana) check you make to control a Sphere of Annihilation

claude_proposed_widenings.name: move_controlled_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The talisman lets the bearer spend a Magic action to move the Sphere of Annihilation (an external game object under their control) up to a calculated distance. No atom exists for translating a controlled external object — force_move is for pushing/pulling creatures, and modify_speed changes the bearer's own walk speed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you start your turn in control of a Sphere of Annihilation, you can take a Magic action to move it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.affine_ability_modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The movement distance is 10 + (10 × INT modifier) feet — a flat base plus a coefficient applied to an ability modifier. DiceAmount.fixed can hold a flat + modifier but has no coefficient multiplier. DiceAmount.fixed.abilityModifier gives +MOD, not +10*MOD.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: move it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier
